name: Karen Naru Daraku
source:
The Chinese Federation have captured Karen, and interrogate her to find out the secrets about Zero and the Knights.
However she stubbornly refuses to talk, and the Federation subjects her to gruesome torture.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044194.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
卡莲遭中华联邦俘虏。为了问出ZERO与黑色骑士团的秘密，对方开始审讯她。
然而她始终拒绝开口，中华联邦于是对她施以残酷拷问。

[编译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE044194.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
